description: Prepare a checkout for a quoted cart without account login. Requires quoted version, expected_total in SGD cents and an idempotency_key. Locks the cart and returns checkout_id, details_version and a review link. Contact/delivery details can be added through set_checkout_details or the browser. Does not charge a payment.

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

name: create_checkout
